characters.name: Buck
characters.description: A large St. Bernard and Scotch shepherd cross, raised as the comfortable favourite of a California estate, who is stolen and sold north to pull sleds in the Yukon.

characters.name: Judge Miller
characters.description: The owner of the sunny Santa Clara Valley estate where Buck spends his first four years.

characters.name: Manuel
characters.description: One of the Judge's gardeners, whose gambling debts lead him to sell Buck to strangers.

characters.name: The man in the red sweater
characters.description: A dog breaker in Seattle who teaches Buck, with a club, that a man with a weapon is to be obeyed.

characters.name: Perrault
characters.description: A French-Canadian courier for the Canadian government who buys Buck and drives the mail team at speed.

characters.name: François
characters.description: Perrault's partner and the team's driver, rough but fair with the dogs.

characters.name: Curly
characters.description: A friendly Newfoundland bought with Buck, whose fate on the beach at Dyea shows Buck how hard the new world is.

characters.name: Spitz
characters.description: The team's lead dog, a cunning and quarrelsome husky who sees Buck as a rival from the start.

characters.name: Dave
characters.description: A withdrawn wheel dog who asks only to be left alone and to work in the traces.

characters.name: Sol-leks
characters.description: An old one-eyed husky who wants nobody approaching his blind side.

characters.name: Hal
characters.description: A young newcomer to the north who buys the worn-out team and drives it with more confidence than sense.

characters.name: John Thornton
characters.description: A gold seeker resting a frozen foot by the White River, who treats his dogs as friends.
